question: The average of the three numbers is 30. If the value of C is six times of the value of A and the value of A is half the value of B. Find the value of A + B - C.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **A : B : C** = 1 : 2 : 6 (since A = B/2 and C = 6A).

Total ratio units = 1 + 2 + 6 = 9 units.

Total sum of numbers = **Average × Count** = 30 × 3 = 90.

Value of 1 unit (A) = 90 ÷ 9 = 10.

Required value (A + B − C) in units = 1 + 2 − 6 = −3 units.

Final Value = −3 × 10 = −30.

**∴ The correct answer is -30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of **A, B, and C** = 30

C = 6 × A

A = B ÷ 2 ⇒ B = 2 × A

**Formula:** Sum = Average × Number of terms

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f723b35ce163457dc2a1dd96123f1bb3b1e97fd75ac3b139ed92fac349196d0b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Sum = A + B + C = 30 × 3 = 90

⇒ Let A = x, then B = 2x and C = 6x

⇒ x + 2x + 6x = 90

⇒ 9x = 90

⇒ x = 10

⇒ A = 10, B = 20, C = 60

⇒ A + B − C = 10 + 20 − 60

⇒ A + B − C = 30 − 60 = −30

**∴ The correct answer is -30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Concept

The **average** of n numbers is the sum of the numbers divided by n. Formula: Average = ∑xᵢ ÷ n.

Ratio and Proportion

When multiple variables are related to a single common variable, expressing them in a **ratio format** simplifies the calculation of their individual values.

Linear Equations

A **linear equation** in one variable (like 9x = 90) can be solved by isolating the variable to find the base unit of comparison.</p
